attributes.action: Knight Djed Spence for his contributions to football
attributes.additional_details: Players who play with passion in the face of a country with a media that have a culture of negativity need to know that they are being rewarded. While I also believe Bellingham also deserves the same there’s something special about a left back making game saving tackles and earning penalties that really resonates with what I believe this county needs more of. There’s not enough hope in the UK and DJed Spence is an example of what the country needs more of he embodies hope itself.
attributes.background: I would like the UK government to fully grasp the importance of football to the country and make a public effort to reward players who play there hearts out for the country
